run_vq_wav2vec_featurize: run the vq-wav2vec script to pre-compute vector quantized embeddings for a flashlight audio dataset
run_DatasetWriter_process_splits: run the DatasetWriter to process audio data splits and extract quantized features from wav files
run_DatasetWriter_iterate: run the iterate method to extract vector quantized indices from audio waveforms using a fairseq model
run_FilesDataset_getitem: run the FilesDataset getitem method to load a wav file and return its audio tensor and label
run_DatasetWriter_load_model: run the load_model method to load a fairseq vq-wav2vec checkpoint and prepare it for feature extraction
